root_cause: Independent Oct 29 release incidents proved that metadata escaping, missing canonical learning test contracts, website-only tenant-proof skip and missing Supabase Edge config can each leave recovery unresolved or falsely inferred green across agents.
change: Extend existing AGENTS.md and powerhouse-continuity skill with read-before-write fingerprints, durable Brain registry occurrence+promotion receipts, evidence separation, bounded recovery and exact provider readback; no new authority or scheduler.
prevention: Next agent must discover these fingerprints first; use protected current SHA and one canonical writer; log every real failure via brain_observe_failure and read back registry; do not promote above OBSERVED without proof. Enforce policy/inheritance with a tests/brain- regression.

evidence.security_boundary: no secrets or customer payloads in public learning
evidence.proof_limits: Static source and DB registry receipts do not establish portal production, checkout user flows or customer business outcomes
